name: soul
description: Persistent identity, memory, and personality for any coda session

soul.subcommands: init status reflect dream commit help

coda_soul_init.description: Initialize identity files (SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, PROJECT.md, memory/, learnings/, dreams/) in a directory

template.description: Path to a custom SOUL.md template

from.description: Clone identity from another soul directory

coda_soul_status.description: Show current identity summary (name, role, memory stats)

coda_soul_reflect.description: Trigger reflection against current soul -- deep synthesis, propose personality updates

coda_soul_dream.description: Write a dream entry for the current soul

coda_soul_commit.description: Safe-commit memory/learnings changes (whitelist-only commit and push)
